source.title: Experimental data of 1 kW lab-scale ORC testbed
source.repository_policy: The original workbook remains in ignored tmp storage. The mechanically normalized measurements.csv is redistributed under CC BY 4.0 with attribution; the repository also tracks the exact source checksum, measurement contract, and reproducible derived results.

normalized_artifact.transformation: The two workbook sheets were inner-joined by Case, headers were expanded to descriptive snake_case names with units, and numeric values were serialized without rounding. No measurement was filtered, imputed, or altered.

associated_publications.title: Experimental and numerical analysis on low-temperature off-design organic Rankine cycle in perspective of mass conservation
associated_publications.use: Source experiment, pressure formation, charge distribution, and passive receiver design.

associated_publications.title: Development of a fully deterministic simulation model for organic Rankine cycle operating under off-design conditions
associated_publications.use: Published full-system modeling method and comparison envelope; reports simulation energy-balance error below 0.3% and experimental comparisons within 8%.

associated_publications.title: Numerical and experimental investigation on thermal-hydraulic characteristics of a scroll expander for organic Rankine cycle
associated_publications.use: Related test-rig scroll-expander geometry, leakage, heat-transfer, and component-validation methodology.

sheets.name: External parameters
sheets.role: Known or controlled system boundaries plus measured source/sink outlet states

sheets.name: Internal parameters
sheets.role: Measured working-fluid component boundary states, mass flow, and expander torque

interpretation_limits: The workbook contains steady averaged operating points, not raw instrument time series.
Instrument uncertainty and component geometry are not encoded in the workbook itself; they must be sourced from the papers before uncertainty-qualified acceptance.
Measured internal states may be used as independent targets or for a boundary-constrained accounting audit, but never as inputs to a result classified as external-boundary prediction.
The published 8% comparison envelope is context for the authors' complete model, not an automatic Thermox acceptance waiver.
